method: Paired parameter comparison on the same engine revision, seed, map and bot; before restores only player/weapon/evolution definitions. Enemy AI, health, collision, XP, loot and normal upgrade callbacks remain untouched. No permanent upgrades, prepared inventory or stars. 30 Hz, 360 s limit. RNG diverges after different kills/loot, so samples are paired by initial seed, not identical later encounters.
